summary: Frontend-only E2E of Correspondence Phase 3 (Arabic RTL): signature upload card on /corr-dashboard (upload/delete/sha prefix), letterhead seal upload slot (lh-upload-seal_asset_id with label 'ختم الجهة'), public /verify-correspondence valid + invalid token flows (both tokens working with all required rows), PDF buttons on issued and draft correspondences (text 'PDF الرسمي'/'PDF مسودة'; window.open popup fires), placeholder insert menu starred (★) suggestions on STUDENT-linked compose (14 starred including input.destination & student.*), full signature lifecycle on NEW draft (PRES-2026-000002 issued) with A4 s8 showing .sig-block + img.sig-img + img.seal-img + 'وُقّع إلكترونياً مدير النظام', new verify_token valid on public page. ONE NEW CRITICAL frontend bug: smart template suggestions UI never renders (compose-suggested-title missing, 0 compose-sugg-* cards) because /correspondence/suggestions API is never called from the compose page — useEffect dependency bug in corr-compose.tsx.

ui_bugs.issue: compose-suggested-title header and compose-sugg-<CODE> cards NEVER render. Backend GET /api/correspondence/suggestions?correspondence_id=... returns 200 with proper {templates:[{score:3.17, reasons:['نفس نوع الوثيقة', ...]}, ...]} but frontend never fires the request (verified via page.on('request')). RCA: in /app/frontend/app/corr-compose.tsx the useEffect that calls corrAPI.suggestions(id) has dependency array [id, bundle?.content?.template_id]. On first mount bundle is null → condition `id && bundle && !bundle.content` is false → skipped. After bundle loads, template_id is still undefined so the array doesn't change → effect never re-fires. Fix: change deps to [id, bundle, bundle?.content?.template_id] (or [id, !!bundle, bundle?.content?.template_id]).

img.sig-img and img.seal-img are injected inside a section via dangerouslySetInnerHTML, but their src attrs are the plain '/api/files/...png' URLs WITHOUT any ?auth=. /api/files/* requires Bearer auth and returned 401 (seen in console). fixSrc in A4Preview is supposed to rewrite /api/files src with ?auth=token, but these two images were not rewritten (naturalWidth=0 when queried). On screenshot they DID eventually render (likely retried); investigate whether fixSrc only targets explicit patterns or misses whitespace / class attributes. Check A4Preview.tsx fixSrc regex.

Creating a new correspondence with corr-create-ext-org filled does NOT persist the recipient (recipients list is empty afterwards). Workaround required: POST /api/correspondence/{id}/recipients afterward. Blocks the UI-only submit flow for external-only drafts.

integration_issues.issue: No network request to /suggestions is made; feature completely invisible to users

critical_code_review_comments: signature_html correctly conditionals on status in {SIGNED, ISSUED, ARCHIVED} and appends to the SIGNATURE_BLOCK html post-render — this works even for frozen snapshots because sig HTML is applied AFTER snapshot resolution (correspondence_content.py:719-724). Good design.
Public verify endpoint intentionally exposes only non-PII fields (official_number, status, dates, sha256) — correct privacy posture; hint text makes that explicit on the page.

Suggestions endpoint scoring (correspondence_signature.py:118-137) is well-structured: doc-type match +3, entity match +2, org-template +1, usage decay by 90d — exposed as 'reasons' chips. Backend design is solid; only frontend wiring is bugged.

corrAPI.suggestions call pattern GET /correspondence/suggestions?correspondence_id= is unusual (vs REST /correspondence/{id}/suggestions). Works but inconsistent with transition endpoints (/correspondence/{id}/{action}). Consider aligning routes.

rca of the issue: Smart suggestions silent failure: useEffect in corr-compose.tsx with deps [id, bundle?.content?.template_id] — initial run has bundle=null so skipped; subsequent bundle updates leave template_id=undefined (new drafts have no content), so the shallow-equal check in React treats the dep tuple as unchanged and the effect never re-fires. Add `bundle` (object identity changes on each load) or `!!bundle` to the dep array to trigger the fetch once bundle hydrates. Direct curl of GET /api/correspondence/suggestions?correspondence_id=<new_id> returned 200 with templates:[{code:'STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_CERTIFICATE',score:3.17,reasons:['نفس نوع الوثيقة','استُخدم 2× في جهتك مؤخراً','استخدمته مؤخراً']}, ...] — confirming backend works.
